message.content: {"caption":"A memory-augmented decision process showing how states, retrieved cases, actions, rewards, and stored experiences connect over time.","description":"The diagram shows a repeating sequence of time steps 0, 1, …, t. At each step, state s links to case c, action a, and reward r, while memory M connects to the case and is updated across steps.
